author: TeIq
content: APPROVE-WITH-FOLLOW-UPS verdict from architect audit. Both dispatches landed cleanly: Dispatch 1 (polaris-setup CLI + install.sh + publish-image.yml + compose image-swap) verified — build clean, clippy -D warnings clean, 565 lib tests + 13 setup-bin tests pass, live setup CLI generates .env (0600) and client-metadata.json correctly, conflict path exits 1 with verbatim error message. Dispatch 2 (README + quick-start + new upgrade.md + new helm/systemd READMEs) — 1007 lines of docs across 5 files, every documented flag verified real via --help, no broken intra-doc links, 8-section upgrade.md covers TL;DR through validation. Filed 3 follow-up issues for honest inconsistencies the subagent flagged (helm tag suffix, install.sh exit-code divergence, POLARIS_VERSION binary-fetch not implemented). Operator path is now: curl install.sh → polaris-setup prompts → docker compose up.
